info.name: Campus Shoes - Support
info.description: Retailer support-ticket system: raise a ticket with optional image attachments (uploaded separately via /s3/upload/base64 or /s3/upload/file, then referenced by URL here), track status, and see resolution remarks. Admin (SUPERADMIN) can list every ticket, view detail, and update status + add remarks. Every endpoint is @NoCache().

variable.description: JWT for a SUPERADMIN user, used on the Admin folder

request.description: DB-backed options for the 'Issue Type' dropdown on the raise-ticket screen (support_issue_types table, seeded to match the SupportIssueType enum). Response: [{ code, label }, ...], active rows only, ordered by display_order. Call this before 'Create ticket' to populate the Select Type field.

issueType: QR_ISSUE | REWARD_ISSUE | PAYMENT_ISSUE | KYC_ISSUE | ORDER_ISSUE | OTHER. images is optional, up to 5 URLs — upload each file first via POST /s3/upload/base64 (or /s3/upload/file) and pass the returned URL here; this endpoint does not accept raw file uploads.

query.description: QR_ISSUE | REWARD_ISSUE | PAYMENT_ISSUE | KYC_ISSUE | ORDER_ISSUE | OTHER

request.description: Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }. Matches the 'My Tickets' list/tabs screen.
Response: { open, inProgress, resolved, total }. Matches the 'In Progress 8 / Resolved 98' counters on the Support home screen.

Scoped to the caller's own tickets — SUP_001 if it belongs to someone else or doesn't exist. Includes attachments and, once touched by an admin, updatedByAdmin (name shown next to 'Last Updated') and resolution_remarks.

item.name: Admin
item.description: SUPERADMIN role only. Auth override: uses {{adminAccessToken}} instead of the collection-level {{accessToken}}.

query.description: QR_ISSUE | REWARD_ISSUE | PAYMENT_ISSUE | KYC_ISSUE | ORDER_ISSUE | OTHER

request.description: Every retailer's tickets, unscoped. Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.
Unscoped — any ticket by id. SUP_001 if not found.

status: OPEN | IN_PROGRESS | RESOLVED (required). remarks optional except when status is RESOLVED, where it's required — SUP_002 if omitted. Records the acting admin as updatedByAdmin. Errors: SUP_001 ticket not found, SUP_002 resolution remarks required.
